body:
## Objective
Create low/mid-fidelity wireframes covering the Customer module flows (list with search/filter, create/edit form, detail view, and soft-delete/restore actions).

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Wireframes committed for Customer list, search/filter controls, create/edit forms (including `payTerms` field), and soft-delete/restore actions
- [ ] Layout aligns with the approved Hope, Inc. main page sidebar and design system

## Definition of Done
- [ ] Single-responsibility PR linked with `Closes #<issue-number>`
- [ ] Peer-reviewed and merged into `main`

milestone.title: Sprint 2
milestone.description: Sprint 2 (Customer & Product Modules): Database views, constraints, price-history queries, and Customer/Product UI + API workflows with server-side RBAC enforcement.
